description: A handmade sports equipment manufacturing company makes basketballs and footballs. Basketballs require 5 units of materials and 1 hour to make whereas footballs require 3 units of materials and 2 hours to make. The manufacturing company has available 1500 units of materials and their workers working at max capacity can work for at most 750 hours. Since basketballs sell better, there must be at least three times as many basketballs as footballs but the manufacturing company would like at least 50 footballs. How many of each should the manufacturing company make to maximize the total number of sports equipment produced?

NumProducts.definition: Number of different sports equipment produced

MaterialRequirement.definition: Amount of materials required to produce one unit of each sports equipment

TimeRequirement.definition: Amount of labor hours required to produce one unit of each sports equipment

TotalMaterialsAvailable.definition: Total units of materials available for production

TotalLaborHoursAvailable.definition: Total labor hours available for production

MinBasketballToFootballRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of basketballs to footballs production

MinimumFootballs.definition: Minimum number of footballs to produce

objective.description: Maximize the total number of sports equipment (basketballs and footballs) produced

constraints.description: 5 times the number of basketballs plus 3 times the number of footballs should not exceed 1500 units of materials
1 times the number of basketballs plus 2 times the number of footballs should not exceed 750 labor hours
The number of basketballs produced should be at least three times the number of footballs produced
The number of footballs produced should be at least 50
